title: theorizing here..
content: i have always felt like mall world is a perception filter over an astral plane of our collective experiences and that feeling is getting stronger. personally, i move a lot and in recent years i've moved to much different environments to what i used to live in and this is reflected within mall world. things i am doing and places i'm going reflect versions of my reality while still reflecting versions of my past lived experiences and all of the experiences that cross over into mall world are shared experiences with the collective of humanity, things almost all of us do regularly or have done in our lives regularly at some point, like going to the mall, going shopping in general, being on the highway, flying on air planes, seeing movies, going to the theatre, skating around a neighborhood that feels familiar and the same every time but doesn't actually match up with any one place you've lived (at least for me this is a huge part of it) going to the cabin, going to your grandparent's house, going to the bathroom, these are all things we normally encounter as a collective in the current world we live in and they carry over to the shared collective dream so many of us have. i think its a perception filter because i think we are all there for our own reasons but being played through the lens of what we can understand. a lot of people i've talked to this about have also figured this out already tbh, i also see people who view the facts within this this observation as "well we all see these things in our daily life of course we are all dreaming about it that doesn't mean anything" but i think it means EVERYTHING
